Follow The Necronomicon from a stolen soul to magic, living machines and gods.
Obtain The Necronomicon. Craft it with a book and a bone.
Obtain soulbone by killing a living creature while holding a bone.
Obtain blue crystal from a cluster. Start one with soulbone and lapis in water over stone.
Obtain yellow crystal from a mature yellow cluster.
Collect all four pieces of Crystal Armor.
Collect a bucket of molten glass, blue crystal or yellow crystal.
Obtain a Blow Mold and Bellows for glassworking.
Collect a Funnel, Decanter, Splitter, Gourd and Spiral.
Obtain a Blue Gem from molten blue crystal and a Gem Mold.
Obtain a Yellow Gem from molten yellow crystal and a Gem Mold.
Obtain a Circuit Stamper. A redstone pulse stamps its four inputs.
Obtain Soulbone Splinters from the Circuit Stamper.
Obtain Soulbone Conduits from splinters and redstone.
Obtain a Control Circuit from a Blue Gem and three conduits.
Obtain a Soulbone Spear to turn bone drops into soulbone.
Collect an Emitter, Ponderance Lattice and Quantifier.
Obtain a Village Detector. Use it to check the nearest village's distance.
Obtain a Soul Gem to carry bottled souls and pay spell costs.
Obtain a Golem Part Assembler to build a permanent body you can pilot.
Obtain a Golem Fabricator. Fit a head, torso, two arms and two legs.
Pilot your own Workshop Golem using a Soul Leash or Incorporeal.
Obtain a Bone Cage to hold creatures for extraction.
Let a Bone Cage you own capture a creature.
Complete a correct four-piece glassware extraction from a cage you own.
Obtain any bottled soul. Catch a released spirit with a glass bottle.
Collect all nine kinds of bottled soul, including God Souls.
Complete a twelve-stone Soul Well ring, or deposit a soul into a working well.
Deposit each of the eight soul kinds into a Soul Well over time.
Obtain a Soul Relay to guide loose souls toward a well.
Obtain a Foci from the Circuit Stamper.
Successfully cast any spell with a Foci.
Obtain a Research Table to write and translate spell books.
Obtain a spell book from loot or a Research Table.
Have a Research Table you own successfully write an encrypted spell book.
Have a Research Table you own successfully translate a spell book.
Learn a non-starter spell from a translated spell book.
Learn every spell that is not known from the start.
Successfully cast Animate Golem or Animate Spider.
Leave your body using a Mirror or Incorporeal. Shelter the body you leave behind.
Possess a creature using a Soul Leash or Incorporeal.
Successfully cast every spell with a Foci at least once.
Obtain an Infusion Table. Place eight plinths around it, all on Soul Stone.
Start an infusion and let the complete ritual finish.
Collect all four pieces of Soulbone Armor.
Obtain Raw Saronite through infusion with a Doomed soul.
Obtain a Soul Forge and supply it with worker souls from a nearby well.
Obtain a Saronite Ingot from a Soul Forge.
Collect a Saronite Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe.
Release a creature's soul with a killing blow from your Saronite Sword or Saronite Arrow.
Collect all four pieces of Saronite Armor.
Obtain a God Soul. Harvest one with a Saronite Sword's final blow and a carried glass bottle.
Obtain a Ring of Power, or complete its infusion with five God Souls.
Start and complete every infusion recipe at least once.
Obtain a Deity Fabricator. Prepare a God Soul and a unique three-item code.
Complete a Deity Fabricator ritual and bring your named god into the Pantheon.
Consult a Pantheon to discover gods, their codes, sacred items and standing.
Dedicate a shrine using three Offering Plates and a god's code. The god may be yours or another player's.
Offer a god's sacred item at its shrine and earn worship.
Become devout by worshipping the same god five times in a row.
While devout, bind a Priest Rod at your god's shrine.
Successfully use your Priest Rod's Blessing. Select with left-click, then cast with right-click.
Successfully use your Priest Rod's Curse on a non-devout target.
Invoke your god's Power while it leads the Pantheon, including a tie.
Spend worship to travel between two shrines of the same god.
Obtain a Deity Hammer. Prepare an open arena and three plates holding a god's code.
Activate a Deity Hammer and complete the avatar's descent. Be ready for an endgame battle.
Defeat an avatar as its challenger or an active nearby fighter. Its god is permanently removed from the Pantheon.
Let any automation machine you own complete a job.
Let a machine of this type that you own place a block.
Let a machine of this type that you own break a block.
Let a machine of this type that you own harvest and replant a mature crop.
Let a machine of this type that you own collect a dropped item.
Let a machine of this type that you own shear a sheep.
Let a machine of this type that you own feed a pair of animals for breeding.
Let a machine of this type that you own fell a tree and replant a sapling.
Let each of the seven automation machines you own complete a job.
Obtain a Ceremonial Robe for offerings at the Altar of Souls.
Obtain an Altar of Souls. Wear your robe and bring four souls and a matching offering.
Complete an offering at the Altar of Souls and receive an enchanted book.
Complete an offering with each of the eight soul kinds.
Obtain a Corporeal Reconstructor. Build its ring and cage near a well with a Wise soul.
Rebuild an undead captive in a Corporeal Reconstructor using a cage you own.
